sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.

sentences.en: After the longest and costliest shutdown in its history, Broadway is attempting to reopen this week.
sentences.zh: 在经历了其历史上最长、代价最高昂的停摆之后，百老汇正试图在本周重新开放。

sentences.en: But it's returning to a vastly different world.
sentences.zh: 但它正在重返一个截然不同的世界。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Michael Paulson, on one show's journey back to the stage.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事迈克尔·保尔森将讲述一部剧重返舞台的历程。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 9 月 17 日，星期五。

sentences.en: Michael, you write about theater for The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你为《纽约时报》撰写戏剧评论。

sentences.en: And so I want you to describe the significance of Broadway's attempt to come back to life this week in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以我想请你描述一下本周百老汇试图在纽约复活的重要意义。

sentences.en: Yeah, look, you have to understand, this is a shutdown without any historical precedent.
sentences.zh: 对，你看，你得明白，这是一次史无前例的停摆。

sentences.en: Broadway has been closed for a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 百老汇已经关闭了一年半。

sentences.en: After the terrorist attacks of September 11th, it was only closed for two days.
sentences.zh: 在 9·11 恐怖袭击之后，它只关闭了两天。

sentences.en: I've seen labor disruptions and weather events.
sentences.zh: 我见证过劳资纠纷和天气事件。

sentences.en: It has never been closed for anything like this length of time.
sentences.zh: 它从来没有像这样长时间关闭过。

sentences.en: And no one could have imagined how long it turned out to be.
sentences.zh: 而且没有人能想象它竟然会持续这么久。

sentences.en: It's been devastating for the industry and for the city.
sentences.zh: 这对整个行业和这座城市来说都是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: Broadway, of course, is a home for a lot of artists and a good-paying home.
sentences.zh: 当然，百老汇是许多艺术家的家园，也是一个薪酬优厚的家园。

sentences.en: It also is a place that creates a lot of economic impact for restaurants and taxi drivers and hotels.
sentences.zh: 它也是一个为餐馆、出租车司机和酒店带来巨大经济影响的地方。

sentences.en: And it's also a symbol of the city.
sentences.zh: 它也是这座城市的象征。

sentences.en: And as long as Broadway has been closed, it has sent a signal that New York is not fully back.
sentences.zh: 只要百老汇一直关门，它就在发出一个信号：纽约还没有完全恢复。

sentences.en: So now Broadway is coming back, or at least it's trying to.
sentences.zh: 所以现在百老汇正在回归，或者至少它在尝试回归。

sentences.en: Just this week, we saw five shows starting or restarting performances, including some of the biggest shows in Broadway history, like The Lion King and Wicked and Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 就在本周，我们看到五部剧开始或重新开始演出，其中包括百老汇历史上一些规模最大的剧目，比如《狮子王》、《魔法坏女巫》和《汉密尔顿》。

sentences.en: But there's one show starting performances today, Friday, that's an especially poignant example of all that's at stake.
sentences.zh: 但今天（周五）有一部开始演出的剧，它是所有这一切命悬一线的特别辛酸的例子。

sentences.en: And it's a new musical called Six.
sentences.zh: 这是一部名为《六美图》的新音乐剧。

sentences.en: And what can you tell me about the show?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我关于这部剧的什么信息吗？

sentences.en: Divorced.
sentences.zh: 离婚。

sentences.en: Beheaded.
sentences.zh: 斩首。

sentences.en: Survived.
sentences.zh: 存活。

sentences.en: So Six is a British pop musical about the wives of Henry VIII.
sentences.zh: 所以《六美图》是一部关于亨利八世妻子的英国流行音乐剧。

sentences.en: You might remember he was married six times, and none of the marriages worked out all that well.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得他结过六次婚，而且这些婚姻结果都不怎么好。

sentences.en: The conceit of the show is that these six wives are presented as contemporary pop stars.
sentences.zh: 这部剧的构思是将这六位妻子呈现为当代的流行歌星。

sentences.en: Yeah, they sing in the styles of, like, Beyonce and Britney Spears, Miley Cyrus, Adele.
sentences.zh: 对，她们的演唱风格类似于碧昂丝、布兰妮·斯皮尔斯、麦莉·赛勒斯、阿黛尔。

sentences.en: Sitting here all alone on a throne In a palace that I happen to own
sentences.zh: 独自坐在王座之上，身处我拥有的宫殿中。

sentences.en: Bring me some pheasant Cupid on the bone And they're dressed in these kind of costumes that have, like, elements of Tudor architecture and contemporary nightclub party wear.
sentences.zh: 给我拿点野鸡肉，带骨的丘比特。她们穿着这种融合了都铎建筑元素和当代夜店派对服装的服饰。

sentences.en: It's super fun.
sentences.zh: 超级有趣。

sentences.en: Really poppy, energetic confection.
sentences.zh: 非常流行、充满活力的糖果般的作品。

sentences.en: But it's also kind of about something serious.
sentences.zh: 但它也关乎一些严肃的事情。

sentences.en: It's a revisionist, feminist take on who these women were.
sentences.zh: 这是对这些女性身份的一种修正主义、女性主义解读。

sentences.en: Paid for with my own riches When my hounds had released the bitches
sentences.zh: 用我自己的财富支付，当我的猎犬放出了那些恶犬。

sentences.en: Woof!
sentences.zh: 汪！

sentences.en: Leading up to March of 2020, this show was shaping up to be a really substantial hit on Broadway.
sentences.zh: 在2020年3月之前，这部剧本来有望成为百老汇一部名利双收的超级大热戏。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And why was that?
sentences.zh: 那是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Look, Six has this amazing backstory.
sentences.zh: 你看，《Six》有着非常精彩的幕后故事。

sentences.en: It was dreamed up by these two college students,
sentences.zh: 它是由两个大学生构思出来的，

sentences.en: Toby Marlowe and Lucy Moss.
sentences.zh: 托比·马洛和露西·莫斯。

sentences.en: They were at Cambridge together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起在剑桥大学就读。

sentences.en: You must see them
sentences.zh: 你一定得看看他们

sentences.en: Da-da-da-da-da-no way And they cooked up this show to bring to the Edinburgh Fringe Festival.
sentences.zh: 哒哒哒哒哒，绝不可能，他们凑出了这部剧，准备带去爱丁堡艺穗节。

sentences.en: And it was almost immediately a sensation there.
sentences.zh: 几乎是一转眼，它在那里就引起了轰动。

sentences.en: And they start getting approached by commercial producers who are interested.
sentences.zh: 然后开始有商业制作人主动找上门来表示感兴趣。

sentences.en: They have no idea what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们完全不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Ultimately, they wind up recording a kind of cast album, even before they've had a professional production.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们甚至在进行专业制作之前，就录制了一张某种形式的卡司专辑。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And that album becomes a tiny bit of a sensation.
sentences.zh: 而那张专辑也引起了小小的轰动。

sentences.en: The show takes on a life on social media.
sentences.zh: 这部剧在社交媒体上拥有了生命力。

sentences.en: I remember the show winds up in London.
sentences.zh: 我记得这部剧最后来到了伦敦。

sentences.en: And I took a group of middle school kids on a New York Times trip there the summer of 2019.
sentences.zh: 2019年夏天，我带了一群中学生参加《纽约时报》的旅行团去了那里。

sentences.en: And I was telling the kids that we were going to go see Six.
sentences.zh: 我当时告诉孩子们我们要去看《Six》。

sentences.en: And a couple girls started singing some of the songs for me.
sentences.zh: 结果有几个女孩开始为我唱起里面的几首歌。

sentences.en: And I'm like, how do you know those songs?
sentences.zh: 我说，你们怎么会唱这些歌？

sentences.en: You've never seen the show.
sentences.zh: 你们又没看过这部剧。

sentences.en: And they said TikTok.
sentences.zh: 她们说是TikTok上听来的。

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm sorry about what I said.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我为我刚才说的话道歉。

sentences.en: And I knew then, like, this has the ingredients to be a hit.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，这具备了成为爆款的潜质。

sentences.en: So the show is a hit in London.
sentences.zh: 所以这部剧在伦敦大获成功。

sentences.en: It's touring the UK.
sentences.zh: 它正在英国巡演。

sentences.en: It's even playing on some cruise ships.
sentences.zh: 甚至还在一些游轮上演出。

sentences.en: But let's be honest, in the theater world, Broadway is the gold standard.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，在戏剧界，百老汇才是黄金标准。

sentences.en: It's the place that commands the most money, the most attention.
sentences.zh: 那是吸金最多、最受瞩目的地方。

sentences.en: And Six is barreling toward what the producers hope is going to be a long and lucrative run here.
sentences.zh: 而《Six》正朝着制作人们期望的在这里长期且暴利的方向大步迈进。

sentences.en: They get a theater.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到了一家剧院。

sentences.en: It's called the Brooks Atkinson Theater.
sentences.zh: 名叫布鲁克斯·阿特金森剧院。

sentences.en: It's on West 47th Street in the heart of Times Square.
sentences.zh: 它位于时代中心西47街。

sentences.en: And as fate would have it, they schedule an opening night for March 12th of 2020.
sentences.zh: 冥冥之中自有天意，他们将首演之夜定在了2020年3月12日。

sentences.en: Can you walk me through your day, March 12th, 2020?
sentences.zh: 你能带我回顾一下2020年3月12日你的一天吗？

sentences.en: I, I, it's, it's, it's, um, yes, I can walk you through that day.
sentences.zh: 我，我，这，这，这，嗯，是的，我可以带你回顾那天。

sentences.en: This week, I went with some of the producers from your show to talk to the cast and crew about what that day and then that night were like.
sentences.zh: 这周，我和你剧组的一些制作人一起去跟演员和剧组人员聊了聊那天以及当晚的情景。

sentences.en: The day started where I took my change of clothes to work.
sentences.zh: 这一天是从我把换洗衣物带到工作地点开始的。

sentences.en: We talked to the American producer, Kevin McCollum, who's a Broadway veteran.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了美国制作人凯文·麦科勒姆，他是一位百老汇资深人士。

sentences.en: He co-produced Rent and Avenue Q, In the Heights.
sentences.zh: 他联合制作了《吉屋出租》、《疯狂原始人》和《身在高地》。

sentences.en: But I knew there was a lot to do that day.
sentences.zh: 但我知道那天有很多事情要做。

sentences.en: And I had all the gifts waiting for everybody at the office that I was going to distribute at the theater.
sentences.zh: 我把准备好送给所有人的礼物都放在办公室里，打算拿到剧院去分发。

sentences.en: And he told us he was getting ready for a big night.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们他正为这个盛大的夜晚做准备。

sentences.en: Of course, he was going to give gifts to the cast and the crew.
sentences.zh: 当然，他要给演员和剧组工作人员送礼物。

sentences.en: You know, I had a lot of people from London here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我这里有很多从伦敦来的人。

sentences.en: And I had also people here from L.A.
sentences.zh: 我这里还有从洛杉矶来的人，

sentences.en: who were working on that.
sentences.zh: 他们都在为此工作。

sentences.en: He knew that all these people had come in from out of town to celebrate the opening night of this show.
sentences.zh: 他知道所有这些人都是从外地赶来庆祝这部剧首演的。

sentences.en: And we had $170,000 of sushi at Tao waiting for us downtown.
sentences.zh: 我们在市中心的Tao餐厅准备了价值17万美元的寿司。

sentences.en: A ton of sushi and I'm sure some six-themed swag, which would be like purple and a lot of crowns.
sentences.zh: 大量的寿司，我敢肯定还有一些带有《Six》主题的小物件，比如紫色和很多王冠。

sentences.en: It's a magical time to look each other in the eye and say, this is what we made together at this time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个神奇的时刻，大家可以看着彼此的眼睛说，这就是我们在这个时期共同创造的成果。

sentences.en: And there will never be another time like this in our lives.
sentences.zh: 在我们的人生中，再也不会有另一个这样的时刻了。

sentences.en: And it's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这很美妙。

sentences.en: It's really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 真的很美妙。

sentences.en: So everything was very much in motion.
sentences.zh: 所以一切都在紧锣密鼓地进行着。

sentences.en: This was going to be a traditional, big opening night.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个传统而盛大的首演之夜。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 千真万确。

sentences.en: But I got to take you back to that period in March of 2020.
sentences.zh: 但我得把你带回2020年3月的那段时间。

sentences.en: There is this pandemic that is sort of closing in.
sentences.zh: 那场大流行病正在逼近。

sentences.en: It has reached America.
sentences.zh: 它已经蔓延到了美国。

sentences.en: It is present in New York.
sentences.zh: 它已经存在于纽约了。

sentences.en: Someone had gotten ill in another show for a matinee the day before.
sentences.zh: 前一天下午场时，另一部剧里有人生病了。

sentences.en: Moulin Rouge!
sentences.zh: 《红磨坊》！

sentences.en: Another musical had canceled its matinee that very day because there were infections in the caSt.
sentences.zh: 另一部音乐剧就在当天取消了下午场，因为演员中出现了感染。

sentences.en: And I had also heard one of our line ushers had been diagnosed as positive, even though they were not in the theater.
sentences.zh: 我还听说我们的一位领座员检测呈阳性，尽管他们当时不在剧院里。

sentences.en: At Hadestown, they banned actors from greeting fans for autographs at the stage door.
sentences.zh: 在《冥界》剧组，他们禁止演员在舞台门口迎接粉丝索要签名。

sentences.en: It was a trickle that then turned into a waterfall of, we're going to have to do something.
sentences.zh: 这只是星星之火，随后演变成了一场瀑布般的浪潮：我们必须采取行动了。

sentences.en: There was a sense that the walls were sort of closing in.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种四面楚歌的感觉。

sentences.en: I got a call at around 11 o'clock from the league saying, you need to come to the league.
sentences.zh: 我在11点左右接到了百老汇联盟的电话，说你得来联盟一趟。

sentences.en: We got some information.
sentences.zh: 我们掌握了一些消息。

sentences.en: And then Kevin gets called to this emergency meeting.
sentences.zh: 然后凯文被叫去开这个紧急会议。

sentences.en: It's at the Broadway League, which is a trade association of theater owners and producers.
sentences.zh: 会议在百老汇联盟举行，这是一个由剧院业主和制作人组成的行业协会。

sentences.en: So I got there and everybody who had a show running was sitting around this table that holds like 40 people.
sentences.zh: 所以我到了那里，所有上演剧目的负责人全都坐在那张能坐大约40人的桌子周围。

sentences.en: But there were like 60 people and they say the governor is going to have a moratorium on performing and he's going to close Broadway at 7 p.m.
sentences.zh: 但现场大约有60人，他们说州长将对演出实施禁令，并将在晚上7点关闭百老汇。

sentences.en: And I raised my hand and I said, excuse me, I have an opening at 6.30 and I have paparazzi coming at 5.
sentences.zh: 我举起手说，打扰一下，我有一场6点半的演出，而且我5点就有狗仔队要来。

sentences.en: And right now it's 12.
sentences.zh: 现在是12点。

sentences.en: We have to get to the governor and we have to say, it has to be 5 or earlier or close it now.
sentences.zh: 我们必须联系州长，必须告诉他们，要么定在5点或更早，要么现在就关闭。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: So that press conference, I think it was about 2.30, 3 o'clock, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以那场新闻发布会，我想大约是2点半、3点左右吧。

sentences.en: Broadway theaters in Manhattan, we're going to affect 5 o'clock today.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿的百老汇剧院，我们将于今天5点起执行。

sentences.en: I was watching it and he did say we're closing Broadway at 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在看直播，他确实说了我们在下午5点关闭百老汇。

sentences.en: We've already been talking to the Broadway theaters and they are aware that we're going to be doing this.
sentences.zh: 我们已经和百老汇剧院沟通过了，他们知道我们要这么做。

sentences.en: So they have notice.
sentences.zh: 所以他们提前收到了通知。

sentences.en: One of my best friends was coming to see the show that night and we had been texting throughout the course of the day.
sentences.zh: 我最好的一位朋友那天晚上要来看演出，我们一整天都在发短信。

sentences.en: And I got a text from her as I'm like about to hop into the shower to get ready.
sentences.zh: 就在我正准备跳进淋浴间洗澡的时候，我收到了她的短信。

sentences.en: So now imagine the cast and crew of 6, their phones start ringing, they're getting texts.
sentences.zh: 所以现在想象一下，《Six》的演员和剧组人员，他们的电话开始响个不停，他们收到了各种短信。

sentences.en: I was about to get into the makeup chair when I started getting all these texts.
sentences.zh: 我正要坐上化妆椅，这时开始收到这些短信。

sentences.en: And the first was from a friend being like, I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 第一条来自一个朋友，说，我太遗憾了。

sentences.en: And she's like, hey, babe, I don't think your show's happening tonight.
sentences.zh: 她发来消息说，嘿，宝贝，我觉得你今晚的演出演不成了。

sentences.en: And I was like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，什么？

sentences.en: They're agents, they're friends.
sentences.zh: 有他们的经纪人，还有他们的朋友。

sentences.en: Everybody wants to know.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想知道情况。

sentences.en: Have you heard?
sentences.zh: 你听说了吗？

sentences.en: Are you okay?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: Like, I went to get my nails done, went to go by atop the after party and then I was in Zara and I got a text from one of our agents here saying,
sentences.zh: 比如，我去做了指甲，顺道去买了庆功派对的衣服，然后我在Zara里收到了我们这里一位经纪人的短信，上面写着：

sentences.en: Have you seen this?
sentences.zh: 你看到这个了吗？

sentences.en: And it was a Playboy article saying, Broadway to go dark as of 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 那是一篇花花公子的文章，上面写着：百老汇将从今天下午5点起暂停营业。

sentences.en: today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: And I was like, what do I do now?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我现在该怎么办？

sentences.en: Like, what, like, logistically happens now?
sentences.zh: 比如，从后勤角度来说，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Like, is everyone okay?
sentences.zh: 比如，大家都还好吗？

sentences.en: Am I going to, like, leave New York tonight?
sentences.zh: 我是不是要今晚离开纽约？

sentences.en: Tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天？

sentences.en: When?
sentences.zh: 什么时候？

sentences.en: Is the city shutting down?
sentences.zh: 这座城市要封城了吗？

sentences.en: Are they going to stop flights?
sentences.zh: 他们要停飞航班吗？

sentences.en: Like, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在就可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，去看看《时报》订户每天都能看到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》App，即可获得30天的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: So, Michael, on a very practical level, after Broadway shuts down, what does everyone involved in this show do?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，从非常现实的层面来讲，在百老汇关门之后，这部剧的所有相关人员都在做什么？

sentences.en: How do they spend their time?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何打发时间的？

sentences.en: Yeah, first it was, oh, it's going to be a month.
sentences.zh: 对，一开始大家的想法是，哦，也就封一个月吧。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: I'm sure you remember, like, at that point, March of 2020, we thought this was going to last a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 我确信你还记得，当时在2020年3月，我们以为这只会持续几个星期。

sentences.en: And then it was like, hmm, it's probably going to be next year.
sentences.zh: 然后就变成了，嗯，估计得持续到明年吧。

sentences.en: And then I was like, okay, I should probably find a job.
sentences.zh: 接着我想，好吧，我大概得找个工作了。

sentences.en: But of course, over time, people started to understand that this was going to last a lot longer than a month.
sentences.zh: 但当然，随着时间的推移，人们开始意识到这远不止持续一个月。

sentences.en: And the cast and crew of six, each of them has to make a decision about what to do.
sentences.zh: 《Six》的演员和剧组人员，每个人都必须对下一步该怎么做做出决定。

sentences.en: I stayed in New York for about six months before I had to make some decisions financially to try to reduce my expenses.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约待了大约六个月，直到财务上不得不做出一些决定来尽量削减开支。

sentences.en: So I ended up...
sentences.zh: 所以我最终……

sentences.en: Everyone working on Broadway got pay and health insurance for a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 所有在百老汇工作的人都获得了几周的薪水和健康保险。

sentences.en: But then it ended, and...
sentences.zh: 但随后它结束了，然后……

sentences.en: We were completely dependent on unemployment, essentially, which was a rocky road for some.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上完全依赖失业救济金，这对一些人来说是一段艰难的道路。

sentences.en: Some people never got it.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至从来没领到过。

sentences.en: Mine took several months.
sentences.zh: 我的花了几个月时间才批下来。

sentences.en: And when it did kick in, it was a lifeline for me.
sentences.zh: 当它真的发下来时，对当时的我和来说简直是救命稻草。

sentences.en: They did what they could to make ends meet.
sentences.zh: 他们尽其所能来维持生计。

sentences.en: And then aside from that, I was doing a lot of virtual voice lessons.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我还上了很多虚拟声乐课。

sentences.en: I was teaching virtually, which is not something I ever thought I would ever do.
sentences.zh: 我开始进行线上教学，这绝对是我从没想过自己会做的事。

sentences.en: You know, the closing was extended and extended and extended.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，停业期限一延再延，延了又延。

sentences.en: Like, I'm sure a bunch of other people, my mental health just plummeted.
sentences.zh: 就像其他许多人一样，我的心理健康状况急剧恶化。

sentences.en: It was a lot of frustration and depression and anxiety over when are we going to come back?
sentences.zh: 关于我们什么时候才能回归，充满了沮丧、抑郁和焦虑。

sentences.en: Is it going to be a year?
sentences.zh: 会是一年吗？

sentences.en: Is it going to be two years?
sentences.zh: 会是两年吗？

sentences.en: Like, why is it taking forever?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这么久？

sentences.en: I've got really strong memories of questioning all of it.
sentences.zh: 我对这一切产生了深深的质疑，记忆犹新。

sentences.en: Because I think, you know, if you're in any other profession, and like, your place of work, your factory shut down for a huge stretch of time, you had to retrain.
sentences.zh: 因为我想，你知道的，如果你从事任何其他行业，比如你的工作场所、你的工厂因为某种原因关闭了很长一段时间，你都得重新接受培训。

sentences.en: There's no way you'd stay in that and be like, no, I'm just going to stick it out.
sentences.zh: 你绝不可能留在那里还说，不，我非要死磕到底。

sentences.en: And so I think there was a sort of real sadness about the future of theatre, which was compelling.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，人们对戏剧的未来产生了一种真实的悲伤感，这种感觉让人百感交集。

sentences.en: And, you know, for some of them, it prompts a kind of existential crisis.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，对其中一些人来说，这引发了一种存在主义危机。

sentences.en: Is this career, this industry, this art form that I love going to work?
sentences.zh: 我所热爱的这个职业、这个行业、这种艺术形式，真的还能运转吗？

sentences.en: My friends who were having to have really serious questions about whether or not it was worth pursuing this career.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友们不得不认真思考，继续追求这份事业是否真的值得。

sentences.en: And then I actually did consider, I was like, what if I never do go back onto the stage?
sentences.zh: 然后我其实真的考虑过，我在想，如果我再也回不到舞台上怎么办？

sentences.en: Like, what will that be like?
sentences.zh: 比如说，那会是什么样？

sentences.en: Should I stay in theatre?
sentences.zh: 我该留在戏剧界吗？

sentences.en: Or is this just too fraught for me?
sentences.zh: 还是说这对我也太折磨了？

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Welcome, everyone.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家。

sentences.en: In May of this year, they finally get some hope.
sentences.zh: 今年五月，他们终于看到了一线希望。

sentences.en: The shows open September 14th.
sentences.zh: 演出将于9月14日开幕。

sentences.en: Governor Cuomo gives Broadway the green light to reopen in the fall.
sentences.zh: 州长科莫亮起绿灯，允许百老汇在秋季重新开放。

sentences.en: They have to have a play to put on.
sentences.zh: 他们必须得有一部能上演的戏剧。

sentences.en: And they're in the process of doing that.
sentences.zh: 他们正在为此做准备。

sentences.en: But the tickets go on sale tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 但门票明天就要开售了。

sentences.en: Yeah, so how did you learn that Six was coming back?
sentences.zh: 对，所以你是怎么得知《Six》要回归的？

sentences.en: And what was that like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I was going to a doctor's appointment.
sentences.zh: 我当时正要去预约看医生。

sentences.en: And I was sitting in the parking lot in my car.
sentences.zh: 我坐在车里的停车场里。

sentences.en: And we all got an email that said, the first show back, September 17th.
sentences.zh: 我们都收到了一封邮件，上面写着，回归的首场演出是9月17日。

sentences.en: This is when tickets are going to go on sale.
sentences.zh: 这就是门票开售的时间。

sentences.en: And we kind of knew about what date it was going to be.
sentences.zh: 我们其实大概知道会是什么日期。

sentences.en: But having that official email with an exact date just, like, put me over the edge.
sentences.zh: 但看到那封带有确切日期的官方邮件，简直让我情绪彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: I was just, like, hot, crying mess in my car.
sentences.zh: 我当时就像个泪人一样，在车里情绪失控。

sentences.en: Then about to walk into the doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 然后正准备走进医务室。

sentences.en: And they're like, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 他们就问，你还好吗？

sentences.en: I was like, yeah, I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 我说，挺好的，我没事。

sentences.en: I'm just really happy.
sentences.zh: 我只是太高兴了。

sentences.en: Like, full emotional breakdown.
sentences.zh: 就是彻底的情绪崩溃。

sentences.en: But it was just that kind of feeling of relief.
sentences.zh: 但这其实是一种如释重负的感觉。

sentences.en: That, okay, I guess we're actually okay enough that we can think about going back.
sentences.zh: 就是，好吧，我想我们的状态恢复得差不多了，可以考虑回去了。

sentences.en: So in August, everybody's back in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以在八月份，大家都回到了纽约。

sentences.en: And they get together for their first rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 他们聚在一起进行第一次排练。

sentences.en: What's it been like being back?
sentences.zh: 回来之后感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: It's been great.
sentences.zh: 感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: It's been crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It's been jarring.
sentences.zh: 有点让人不习惯。

sentences.en: It's been fun.
sentences.zh: 很有趣。

sentences.en: I walked into that session, like, guys, I don't know what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 我走进排练厅时就想，伙计们，我都不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: I'm so scared.
sentences.zh: 我好害怕。

sentences.en: And I'm blah, blah, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 然后我巴拉巴拉说了一大堆。

sentences.en: It's been emotional.
sentences.zh: 百感交集。

sentences.en: It's been tiring.
sentences.zh: 让人精疲力竭。

sentences.en: It's such an emotional moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此情感涌动的时刻。

sentences.en: And they're having to start over.
sentences.zh: 而他们不得不一切从头开始。

sentences.en: I'm terrified.
sentences.zh: 我吓坏了。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, God, can I do this musical again?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，天哪，我还能再演这部音乐剧吗？

sentences.en: I don't even know.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不知道。

sentences.en: I haven't danced in so long and haven't sung eight times a week, for sure.
sentences.zh: 我已经好久没跳舞了，而且肯定没法像以前那样一周演八场。

sentences.en: Can I do it?
sentences.zh: 我能做到吗？

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: They have to relearn all the dance steps.
sentences.zh: 他们得重新学习所有的舞蹈动作。

sentences.en: Like, this is a highly choreographed show.
sentences.zh: 比如，这是一部编舞非常密集的演出。

sentences.en: So we're going straight into the dance break.
sentences.zh: 所以我们直接进入舞蹈排练环节。

sentences.en: You know, your muscle memory retains some of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你的肌肉记忆会保留一部分。

sentences.en: But other parts of it just slip away.
sentences.zh: 但其他部分就这样悄然流失了。

sentences.en: You know, when we got into the rehearsal room and we were going through choreography, it was, I had a lot of people saying, it's just going to be like riding a bike.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们走进排练室过舞蹈动作时，很多人对我说，这就像骑自行车一样简单。

sentences.en: And I'm like, you don't know what this show takes.
sentences.zh: 而我说，你们根本不知道这部剧需要付出什么。

sentences.en: Relax that wriSt.
sentences.zh: 放松那个手腕。

sentences.en: Done.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Are these our last poses?
sentences.zh: 这是我们最后的定格姿势吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Our team was actually really great.
sentences.zh: 我们的团队其实真的非常好。

sentences.en: I don't know if the other girls spoke about it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道其他女孩有没有提过。

sentences.en: It took time to have moments in rehearsal for everyone to kind of check in with everyone and be like, okay, how are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 排练中特意留出时间，让每个人都能和大家交流一下，像是，好吧，你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: And even that, I think for me and for some of us, it was like, oh, how am I feeling?
sentences.zh: 即便如此，对我和我们当中有些人来说，也是一种触动，哦，我感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I haven't really thought about it.
sentences.zh: 我其实根本没想过这个问题。

sentences.en: We've all been kind of just keeping our heads above water for a while.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人一段时间以来都只是在勉强维持。

sentences.en: So even that was, brought some things up.
sentences.zh: 所以哪怕是这样，也勾起了很多情绪。

sentences.en: But ultimately made us more connected and just helped us tune into each other even more.
sentences.zh: 但最终让我们联系得更紧密了，也帮我们更加了解彼此。

sentences.en: And that's been really valuable as we've moved forward, just because we feel more connected and tuned in with each other, which only helps for this show.
sentences.zh: 随着我们不断前行，这真的非常宝贵，因为我们感觉彼此联系更深、更有默契，这对这部剧只有好处。

sentences.en: And of course, for life, which is most important.
sentences.zh: 当然，对生活也是如此，这才是最重要的。

sentences.en: So is there a Groundhog Day quality to this?
sentences.zh: 那么，这有一种《土拨鼠之日》的感觉吗？

sentences.en: I mean, you went all the way through previews.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你们经历了全部的预演。

sentences.en: You've done all this before and here you go again.
sentences.zh: 你们以前做过这一切，现在又要重来一遍。

sentences.en: Do you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: It really doesn't feel Groundhog Day.
sentences.zh: 真的不觉得像《土拨鼠之日》。

sentences.en: There's a Groundhog quality to it of like, you know, like being back in these spaces.
sentences.zh: 它有一种似曾相识的感觉，比如，你知道的，就像重新回到这些空间里。

sentences.en: But like, but it is just like.
sentences.zh: 但是，但它就像是。

sentences.en: When I got into my apartment and it smelled exactly the same as my old apartment, I was like, oh my gosh, like full on Groundhog Day.
sentences.zh: 当我走进我的公寓，闻起来和我旧公寓一模一样时，我当时想，哦天哪，简直就是彻头彻尾的《土拨鼠之日》。

sentences.en: I was like, is this going to be a repeat?
sentences.zh: 我在想，这会是一场重演吗？

sentences.en: But getting into the room, everyone's just a new person bringing their new selves to it.
sentences.zh: 但一进到排练室，每个人都是全新的人，把崭新的自我带到了其中。

sentences.en: And the actors and the writers and everyone involved with Six told us this time away had really changed them.
sentences.zh: 《Six》的演员、编剧和所有相关人员都告诉我们，这段远离舞台的时光确实改变了他们。

sentences.en: Like getting that cab from JFK to midtown and like seeing New York in the flesh, in the cement.
sentences.zh: 就像坐着出租车从肯尼迪机场到市中心，亲眼看到纽约的实体，看到水泥路面。

sentences.en: And I was like, gosh, like I've made it to New York.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，天哪，我终于到纽约了。

sentences.en: That is a really exciting step.
sentences.zh: 这真的是激动人心的一步。

sentences.en: They were back.
sentences.zh: 他们回来了。

sentences.en: Six was finally going to have its big moment on Broadway.
sentences.zh: 《Six》终于要在百老汇迎来它的高光时刻了。

sentences.en: And some of that felt familiar.
sentences.zh: 其中有些感觉很熟悉。

sentences.en: But they all expressed this new sense of appreciation for this moment.
sentences.zh: 但他们都表达了对这个时刻的一种崭新的感激之情。

sentences.en: And then like seeing the queens in rehearsals and being like, wow, so grateful that I'm here.
sentences.zh: 然后就像在排练中看到那些王后角色时会想，哇，太感激能来到这里了。

sentences.en: And just like being in the theater now talking to you.
sentences.zh: 现在就在剧院里和你交谈。

sentences.en: It's like, I'm so grateful we've got this far.
sentences.zh: 就好像，我太感激我们能走到今天这一步了。

sentences.en: I'm going to be like grateful for like every bit of the return of theater.
sentences.zh: 我要对戏剧回归的每一分每一秒都充满感激。

sentences.en: The word they used over and over after such a long time away from each other and from theater was gratitude.
sentences.zh: 在彼此分离以及离开戏剧舞台这么久之后，他们反复提到的一个词就是：感恩。

sentences.en: The gratitude of being here this time around compared to last time around.
sentences.zh: 与上一次相比，这一次身处此地的感恩之情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's so much stronger, which is a really nice experience.
sentences.zh: 要强烈得多，这真的是一种很棒的体验。

sentences.en: I think it's safe to say that everyone is grateful that Broadway is back.
sentences.zh: 可以说，每个人都对百老汇的回归心存感激。

sentences.en: But gratitude is not going to sell out theaters and it's not going to sell out theaters for very long.
sentences.zh: 但感激并不能让剧院座无虚席，而且这种感激之情也不会持续太久。

sentences.en: And it feels like at the end of the day, the question is, will enough people show up?
sentences.zh: 归根结底，问题似乎在于，会有足够多的人来看吗？

sentences.en: Will it be safe?
sentences.zh: 安全吗？

sentences.en: And will this experiment work?
sentences.zh: 这场实验会成功吗？

sentences.en: Will a show like Six make it in the middle of a pandemic?
sentences.zh: 像《Six》这样的剧能在疫情期间存活下来吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, those are hard questions.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些都是艰难的问题。

sentences.en: And the truth is, I don't know the answers yet.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我目前还没有答案。

sentences.en: But what I can tell you is that I'm going to be at six tonight and I've been out all week.
sentences.zh: 但我能告诉你的是，我今晚会去现场看《Six》，而且我一整周都在外面。

sentences.en: Walking up to 49th Street.
sentences.zh: 朝49街走去。

sentences.en: Sometimes with producers from The Daily.
sentences.zh: 有时和《每日新闻》的制作人在一起。

sentences.en: And we've been talking to a lot of people who love theater.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在和许多热爱戏剧的人交流。

sentences.en: They're so happy to be back, but also they're asking these same sorts of questions you are.
sentences.zh: 他们很高兴能回来，但同时他们也在问和你一样的问题。

sentences.en: There you go, first out on the right.
sentences.zh: 给你，右边第一个出口。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I guess it's just really important also, though, to remember that risk and uncertainty and even disappointment, they're all kind of baked into Broadway.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，记住风险、不确定性甚至失望，它们其实都已经是百老汇固有的一部分，这也同样非常重要。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: I'm in Orchestra 112.
sentences.zh: 我在乐队池112座。

sentences.en: Well, most shows don't work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大多数剧都不会成功。

sentences.en: Most shows open and then close relatively quickly in a kind of collapse of disappointment and sometimes recrimination.
sentences.zh: 大多数剧开演后不久就会下档，伴随着失望甚至有时是互相指责的崩溃。

sentences.en: And, you know, just think about all the bumpy journeys told on stage.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，想想舞台上讲述的所有波折的旅程。

sentences.en: Think about Simba in The Lion King and his years in the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 想想《狮子王》里的辛巴以及他在荒野中的岁月。

sentences.en: Think about Alexander Hamilton and his kind of career and almost marriage-ending personal scandal.
sentences.zh: 想想亚历山大·汉密尔顿以及他那几乎断送职业生涯和婚姻的个人丑闻。

sentences.en: And think about a chorus line, which is like directly about the kind of hopes and dreams and endless disappointment
sentences.zh: 再想想《歌舞线上》，它直接讲述了那些极度渴望在戏剧界闯出一片天的人们的希望、梦想、无尽的失望

sentences.en: and unfairness and aggrievedness of people desperately yearning to make their way in the theater.
sentences.zh: 以及不公和委屈。

sentences.en: You know, the stories that these artists are telling are so often about challenge and danger and disappointment and hurdles.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些艺术家所讲述的故事往往关乎挑战、危险、失望和重重阻碍。

sentences.en: And usually it builds toward a happy ending, but not always.
sentences.zh: 通常它会以大团圆结局收尾，但并非总是如此。

sentences.en: And you kind of don't get to know when you first settle into your seat.
sentences.zh: 当你刚坐到位子上时，你其实并不知道结果如何。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So I am now about to find my seat for the show.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我要去找我的座位看演出了。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 哦，不好意思。

sentences.en: No worries.
sentences.zh: 没事。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Well, that was something special.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那真的是一场特别的演出。

sentences.en: Oh yes, that was amazing.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，太棒了。

sentences.en: Have you guys seen this before?
sentences.zh: 你们以前看过这个吗？

sentences.en: Yes, her dog is named Elfie.
sentences.zh: 看过，她的狗叫埃尔菲。

sentences.en: Oh my goodness.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: So like, we're fans for sure.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们绝对是粉丝。

sentences.en: I saw this show for the first time when I was seven.
sentences.zh: 我七岁时第一次看这部剧。

sentences.en: And my parents, I'd listened to the cast album and I was obsessed with it.
sentences.zh: 我的父母，我听过演员专辑，然后我就对它着迷了。

sentences.en: And my parents surprised me and we flew to New York to see the show.
sentences.zh: 我父母给了我一个惊喜，我们飞到纽约来看这部剧。

sentences.en: And I credit that with why I live in New York City now.
sentences.zh: 我认为我现在住在纽约市就要归功于此。

sentences.en: Just like fell in love with Broadway, theater, New York.
sentences.zh: 就是彻底爱上了百老汇、戏剧和纽约。

sentences.en: So this is just kind of like, I don't know, after the last year of everything that we've gone through, it's just very, very full circle, full circle for me.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉就像是，我不知道，在经历了过去一年经历的一切之后，对我来说简直是一个完美的圆满结局，兜兜转转又回到了原点。

sentences.en: Like, it's funny.
sentences.zh: 就像，这很有趣。

sentences.en: There was a big, like, musical theater, TikTok trend.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个非常火的音乐剧TikTok潮流。

sentences.en: Everyone wanted to be at Wicked specifically because the first line of the show is, it's good to see me, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 每个人都想去《魔法坏女巫》现场，特地是因为剧的第一句台词是，见到我很高兴，不是吗？

sentences.en: Like, you don't have to respond.
sentences.zh: 就像，你不用回答。

sentences.en: That was rhetorical.
sentences.zh: 那是句反问。

sentences.en: So everyone wanted to be in this room because it is.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都想来到这个剧场里，因为确实如此。

sentences.en: It's so good to see this show, to see theater be back and have everyone under one roof and in a crowd for the first time in a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 看到这部剧，看到戏剧回归，让大家一年半以来第一次齐聚一堂、身处人群之中，这种感觉真是太好了。

sentences.en: So yeah, it's kind of, it's weird, but also very exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，这有点，这很怪异，但也非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: Here we go again.
sentences.zh: 又来了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, France reacted with fury to its exclusion from an agreement between the United
sentences.zh: 周四，法国对其被排除在美英两国向澳大利亚提供核潜艇的协议之外反应愤怒。

sentences.en: States and Britain to provide nuclear-powered submarines to Australia.
sentences.zh: 该协议旨在应对中国在太平洋地区的军事威胁，破坏了法国向澳大利亚提供潜艇的交易。

sentences.en: The agreement, which is intended to counter the military threat of China in the Pacific, undercut a French deal to provide submarines to Australia.
sentences.zh: 在一场电台采访中，法国外长表示，将法国排除在外的决定是“单方面的、残酷的且不可预测的”，并将其与前总统特朗普的外交政策举措进行了比较。

sentences.en: In a radio interview, France's foreign minister said the decision to exclude France was, quote, unilateral, brutal, and unpredictable, and compared it to the foreign policy actions
sentences.zh: 在一场电台采访中，法国外长表示，将法国排除在外的决定是“单方面的、残酷的且不可预测的”，并将其与前总统特朗普的外交政策举措进行了比较。

sentences.en: carried out by former President Trump.
sentences.zh: 并将其与前总统特朗普的外交政策举措进行了比较。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, China's foreign minister issued his own attack on the agreement, calling it, quote, extremely irresponsible.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，中国外长也对该协议发起了抨击，称其“极其不负责任”。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Sidney Harper, Luke Vanderplug, and Eric Krupke, with help from Chelsea Daniel.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由西德尼·哈珀、卢克·范德普鲁格和埃里克·克鲁普克制作，切尔西·丹尼尔提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Larissa Anderson, engineered by Chris Wood, and contains original music by
sentences.zh: 节目由拉里萨·安德森剪辑，克里斯·伍德担任音频工程，原创音乐由

sentences.en: Aliciava Itoub, Dan Powell, Mary Lozano, and Corey Schreppel.
sentences.zh: 阿利西亚娃·伊图布、丹·鲍威尔、玛丽·洛扎诺和科里·施雷佩尔创作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由来自 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢朱莉娅·雅各布斯、劳拉·佐诺萨和迈克尔·库珀。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Povaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·波瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又惊心动魄的争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》中，由我萨拉·科尼格为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro, listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》，欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
